_doc: Scenarios for verify.mjs (format in harness/design/VERIFY.md 'Scenario options' and the step list in browser.mjs runStep). Each scenario opens a fresh page (index.html?<pageQuery>) or, with kit.config.json target godot, a fresh Godot run (godotdriver.mjs; `headless: true` runs it headless, no shots or perf), runs its steps in order and fails on the first failed step, any console error, a problem a shot rule reports (debug.shotProblems) or a budget over its fail limit (harness/verify/perf_budgets.json). Keep each scenario small and about one thing. Name it <area>_<what>. Add a `_note` that says what it proves and which task added it.

scenarios.name: boot_title
scenarios._note: Kit sample. The first screen the player sees, after the game says ready.

scenarios.name: hooks_contract
scenarios._note: Kit sample. Proves window.__game implements docs/GAME_HOOKS.md: state, clock, frames, input, perf, load, teleport, setCamera, timeScale and the sim hold. The ADOPT phase makes this pass first.

scenarios.name: perf_baseline
scenarios._note: Kit sample. One perf window on the first scene, judged against perf_budgets.json. perfQuick keeps it in --quick; heavier perf scenes should leave perfQuick out so they run in --only and --all.

scenarios.name: hooks_no_debug
scenarios._note: P0-001, ported to Godot in P0-026. Web: opens the game URL without ?debug=1 in an iframe, window.__game.debug is undefined. Godot: the driver launches the game headless without --debug and no port answers (its own and the default), no debug server line, no ERROR lines (GAME_HOOKS.md Rules). The scenario's own debug run is headless (no shot).

scenarios.name: drive_north
scenarios._note: P0-001. Input only: throttle 3 s of sim from heading 0, z falls by over 10 m and abs x stays under 0.5 m (north is -Z).

scenarios.name: drive_turn_right
scenarios._note: P0-001. Input only: throttle plus steer right, heading grows and x becomes positive (east is +X).

scenarios.name: coords_north_marker
scenarios._note: P0-001. Camera at the origin looking north (-Z): the red north post (0,-50) must be in the centre third of the shot. The builder reads the shot.

scenarios.name: street_boot
scenarios._note: P0-009. debug.load('street') builds the stand-in Delhi arterial (median, kerbs, service lane, signal junction, flyover ramp stub, shops, traffic, people); the scene reports its id, the sim runs, a shot is taken, no console errors.

scenarios.name: landmarks_boot
scenarios._note: P0-009. debug.load('landmarks') builds one landmark stand-in per tier (hero arch, signature domed tomb, marker block) with surroundings; the scene reports its id, the sim runs, a shot is taken, no console errors.

scenarios.name: areas_boot
scenarios._note: P0-009. debug.load('areas') builds the two area kit blocks (old city bazaar strip, Lutyens bungalow road) and the third person character stand-in; the scene reports its id, the sim runs, a shot is taken, no console errors.
